**Summary of work so far:**

**Completed:**
- Added `has_path` function to `funcy/colls.py` that returns boolean indicating if path exists in nested collection

**Pending Requirements:**
- **[R1]** Add `has_path` to `__all__` exports and main package namespace; also verify `get_in`, `update_in`, `zip_dicts` remain available
- **[R2]** Verify `update_in` handles empty paths correctly (currently calls `update(coll)` which seems correct, but need to test edge cases)
- **[R3** Add `skip` exception support, `.memory` property, `.invalidate`, `.invalidate_all` methods to `cache` decorator (currently only has `.invalidate` and `.invalidate_all`); `memoize` already has `skip` and `.memory`
- **[R4]** Create `api_call` decorator/context manager and ensure `reraise` passes original exception to callback; expose `api_call` and `fallback` from main namespace
- **[R5]** Add `decorator_fab`, `has_1pos_and_kwonly`, `has_single_arg` to public API; fix keyword-only arg handling in decorators
- **[R6]** Fix `rcurry`/`rpartial` to properly handle kwargs; ensure `get_spec` accurately describes signatures of curried/partially applied functions
- **[R7]** Add `throttle` alias for `limit_error_rate`; make it properly interpret `timedelta` arguments
